args.message:
Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money, per FIN-212

The docstring specified banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail the nightly build
(e.g. 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing `tests/test_money.py` to fail (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
Switched the `quantize` call to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
CI passed on `fix/money-bankers-rounding` (run `ci-0001`), including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
